title: Ten Killed in Sinaloa on Sunday; Mazatlán Accounts for at Least Seven
detail: Preliminary Security Cabinet data cited by Infobae put October 11 homicides in Sinaloa at 10, at least seven in Mazatlán (including two relatives shot on a football field in colonia Klein and a woman killed in Villa Unión). Also reported: Escuinapa's civil protection coordinator Jesús Francisco López Bibriesca shot dead, a fatal attack outside a beer shop in Culiacán's El Mirador, and a body found wrapped in tape in Navolato. About 9,000 troops are deployed in Mazatlán, the conflict's epicentre since July.
